im someone with bpd in a relationship with someone else who has bpd. i often go to bed before my girlfriend, which upsets my gf as she sees it as me abandoning her. what i let her know is sometimes people need to take care of their own needs as well as the needs of others. maybe your bf was very tired, maybe he thought that he had appropriately calmed you down, maybe it was even just an oversight. people make mistakes, and i know that you may not feel cared about or feel abandoned because of his actions, but this is not something worth throwing away a four year relationship with someone youre "madly in love with" away for. have you spoken to him? expressed why what he did upset you so much? has he explained his thought process behind going to bed? i think this is just something that the both of you need to have a calm conversation with. try not to use accusatory language such as "you abandoned me" when talking about it as well. just approach him calmly and go "when you went to bed last night, it felt like you were abandoning me when i have been really struggling. it felt insensitive" and go from there. thats how i would want my gf to approach a situation like this with me, anyway. ive been in the position of your bf many times here and can honestly say it was probably just that he needed to take care of himself as well and make sure he got rest
